title: Chapter 198 - 198 Since You'Re Busy, Let'S Cancel It!

Chapter 198 - 198 Since You'Re Busy, Let'S Cancel It!

Chapter 198 - 198 Since You're Busy, Let's Cancel It!

198 Since You’re Busy, Let’s Cancel It!

The smile on Qiu Ziqian’s face froze.

What did Liu Silu mean?

A flight attendant was a waitress?

In the first-class cabin, they could not wait to kneel down and serve customers?

Qiu Ziqian used to be a flight attendant, so it was clear she was being insulted.

Liu Siqi did not seem to notice the change in Qiu Ziqian’s expression and continued to say, “I didn’t choose to apply for Xia Airlines because I knew about the nature of flight attendants.”

‘What do you mean by you didn’t apply to Xia Airlines because you knew the nature of flight attendants?

‘Who was the one who bribed the interviewer back then and ended up being reported, which is why they weren’t successfully accepted by Xia Airlines?’

Initially, Qiu Ziqian was happy because it was a former classmate she had not seen for two years.

Therefore, even if they were not good friends in the past, she still wanted to have a friendly exchange.

Now it seemed like… there was no need for that.

She treated her as a classmate, but she just wanted to show off.

Liu Siqi said apologetically, “Oh, sorry… I definitely didn’t mean to criticize you… After all, you’re not a flight attendant anymore. You shouldn’t mind, right?”

Qiu Ziqian did not reply.

At this moment, Liu Siqi finally noticed Lin Fan who was beside Qiu Ziqian. She asked, “Oh right, this is…”

“Oh, I’m Ziqian’s boyfriend, Lin Fan,” Lin Fan replied.

“Ziqian, congratulations on ending your singlehood!” Liu Siqi praised.

Lin Fan was just too handsome.

She thought of her fierce-looking husband and could not help but feel jealous.

Speaking of Lin Fan, a sweet smile appeared on Qiu Ziqian’s face. “Thank you.”

She felt that the happiest thing in her life was meeting Lin Fan.

Liu Siqi looked at Qiu Ziqian’s happy face and felt a wave of displeasure. She asked, “Lin Fan, right? What do you do for a living?”

“For the time being… I’m a student at Jiangbei University,” Lin Fan said.

Liu Siqi almost laughed out loud.

She was laughing at Qiu Ziqian for finding a student boyfriend.

Yes!

Lin Fan was handsome!

However, what was the use of being handsome?

Could being handsome put food on the table?

He just had to live a bitter life every day.

Liu Siqi held back her laughter and said, “Ziqian, I’m so envious of you. You found a university student as your boyfriend… In that case, he must have a lot of time to spend with you, right? The two of you must be very happy!

“Sigh, unlike me! I found a husband who runs a company. Let alone accompany me… he’s busy outside every day. Sometimes, I don’t see him even once in half a month.”

Liu Siqi looked helpless and continued, “Just like today. He said he wanted to accompany me, but in the end, the chairman of Yinshan Group and the chairman of Xiao Wu Wholesale City both said they wanted to treat my husband to a meal.

“You guys should have heard of Yinshan Group and Xiao Wu Wholesale City, right? These are two big companies with a market value of tens of billions!

“The chairmen for these two companies can be said to be my husband’s seniors. They keep wanting to treat my husband to a meal, and my husband couldn’t reject them at all…

“Besides, he can’t really let them treat him to a meal. After all, they’re both big seniors.

“So, my husband wants to book a floor at the Imperial Hotel and treat them to a meal instead…”

Liu Siqi spoke with confidence as if everything was the truth.

In reality?

How could the chairman of Yinshan Group and the chairman of Xiao Wu Wholesale City take the initiative to treat her husband to a meal?

It was her husband who had been spending a lot of effort to treat the boss of Yinshan Group and Xiao Wu Wholesale City to a meal.

However, Liu Siqi was not worried about being seen through.

She firmly believed that Qiu Ziqian and Lin Fan would never have any dealings with the chairman of Yinshan Group and Xiao Wu Wholesale City.

Liu Siqi said, “My husband and I are always away. We’re not familiar with the Imperial Hotel at all. We’re struggling a little to book the Imperial Hotel.

“Oh right, Ziqian, Lin Fan, you two have been in Jiangbei, right? Do you know anyone in the Imperial Hotel? Can you help us book a floor?”

Liu Siqi had only said this casually.

A student and a young woman… How could they possibly know someone from the Imperial Hotel?

It was just a joke!

In fact, her husband had never even thought of booking a floor of the Imperial Hotel.

That was the Imperial Hotel!

It would probably cost hundreds of thousands to cover one floor!

Were they crazy?

Her purpose was to show off her husband’s strength.

At this moment, Lin Fan smiled and said, “The Imperial Hotel? I do know someone. I should be able to help you.”

Then, Lin Fan picked up his phone and dialed the number of the general manager of the Imperial Hotel, Wang Fengyi.

The call went through very quickly.

“Hello, Mr. Lin,” Wang Fengyi said excitedly.

Lin Fan said, “Manager Wang, someone wants to book a floor at the Imperial Hotel. Is that possible?”

“Most of the halls in our hotel have been reserved,” said Wang Fengyi. “If they want to book a floor, they can choose our top-floor luxury hall.”

Lin Fan nodded. “Alright, as long as it’s possible! You can contact them directly later. They don’t lack money.”

“Yes!” Wang Fengyi replied.

For Wang Fengyi to be able to become the general manager of the Imperial Hotel, he could be said to be the smartest among the smartest. How could he not understand what Lin Fan was saying?

Then, he directly dialed the number Lin Fan sent him.

…

“Lin Fan, who did you send my husband’s number to?” Liu Siqi asked curiously.

“I sent it to the general manager of the Imperial Hotel. He said that he can book a luxury hall for you,” Lin Fan said.

“Is that so?” Liu Siqi almost laughed out loud.

The general manager of the Imperial Hotel? A luxurious room on the top floor?

Lin Fan was a student!

She was about to laugh to death!

Lin Fan said, “Oh, right, you and your husband… It seems that you guys don’t want to eat with the chairman of Yinshan Group and the chairman of Xiao Wu Wholesale City. In that case, you shouldn’t have to.

“You just said that your husband’s name is Chen Kai, right?”

Then, Lin Fan picked up his phone and dialed the number of the chairman of Xiao Wu Wholesale City, Zhang Zhou.

As soon as the call connected, Zhang Zhou’s extremely respectful voice sounded from the other end.

“Hello, Mr. Lin.”

“Zhang Zhou, are you going to have dinner with someone called Chen Kai?” Lin Fan asked.

“He did ask me out a few times, but I haven’t agreed yet…” Zhang Zhou said carefully.

Even though Zhang Zhou was a shrewd person, facing Lin Fan’s sudden question, he had to answer carefully.

“It’s fine even if you don’t agree. Don’t agree in the future! He wants to have dinner with his wife,” Lin Fan said.

“Got it!” Zhang Zhou replied respectfully.

Then, Lin Fan dialed the number of the chairman of Yinshan Group, Song Zhifeng.

“Hello, Mr. Lin.”

“Song Zhifeng, are you having dinner with Chen Kai?” Lin Fan asked.

“Yes, he made a reservation at a restaurant tonight,” Song Zhifeng answered truthfully.

“Just reject it. Also, don’t eat with him in the future. He wants to accompany his wife,” Lin Fan said.

“Alright,” Song Zhifeng quickly responded.
